newsitem.title: USA: CME feeder cattle rise to new highs on fund buying.
newsitem.headline: CME feeder cattle rise to new highs on fund buying.

text.p: CME feeder cattle futures surged to new contract highs as local and fund demand touched off buy stops, traders said.

Back months had posted new contract highs earlier and nearbys followed after working through chart resistance on buying sparked by strong cash ideas. Buy stops reinforced the advance after pushing through August's old high, they said.

August ran up to a new high of 79.700 cents per lb, up 1.100 cent before profit taking pared gains. August currently was trading up 0.700 cent at 79.300 cents per lb and other months were up 0.325 to 0.750 cents.
